node.statement: Lemma 6.1 (Partial trace helper): For any 1 <= k <= n, E_lambda[tr_{A_{k+1}...A_n, B_1...B_n}(tau_lambda(rho))] = rho^{tensor k}, where tau_lambda(rho) = Phi^{d,r}(rho|_lambda) is the purification channel output conditioned on Schur sampling outcome lambda, and E_lambda averages over the Schur sampling distribution. Proof: By Lemma 3.4, tr_{Y'P'Q'}(Phi^{d,r}(rho|_lambda)) = rho|_lambda. Tracing out the extra A and B registers then gives the k-copy marginal. Averaging over lambda uses Lemma 3.5.
